items.text: Fixed frog animations not playing, corrected sideways skating and movement speed issues.
Added a water‑drinking need and behavior to livestock, allowing them to drink from nearby containers or natural water sources.
Frog NPC gains a new “interested” state: it searches for shallow water and starts croaking.
Introduced a restoreHierarchy field for poolable objects applied to vehicles, fixing UI pooling issues.
Adjusted suspension, steering, and grip; removed non‑functional burnout/launch; engine revs now use front wheel speed; rear wheels visually lock during handbrake.
Aim sway now scales with movement speed when aiming held weapons from the passenger seat of the attack helicopter.
Building volumes are now correctly ignored during navmesh baking, and navmesh generation no longer creates unintended areas or fails, improving NPC path‑following reliability.
Fixed a potential null‑reference crash for mannequins.
Optimized NPC path‑following logic, roughly doubling performance via selective string‑pulling and reduced interop calls.
SAM sites now have proximity fuses against drones, 2.25× lead speed, and can destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air.
Unused pies receive doubled bonus durations, and hunters pie bleed reduction increased to 90%.
Medkits reduce radiation by 20; boat planner tech tree cost lowered to 30; longsword swing radius and delay adjusted for faster, more accurate attacks.
Swamp tree wood harvest increased to 1000 and oil rig crates now persist across server restarts with refined puzzle resets and improved save/load logic.

Added a configurable convar for drone detonation distance; ammo models now display remaining rounds for applicable revolvers; tax collector upkeep cost scales with authenticated player count via tiered percentages; random skin crafting can now yield the default skin.

Various UI fixes: store prop drawer fallback image, FadeCanvasGroup null‑reference protection, corrected arrow revamp icons, hotbar swapping with overstacks moved server‑side, repair bench functionality restored, and cached skin ID issue resolved.

2026-08-24.summary:
### Animals
- Fixed frog animations not playing, corrected sideways skating and movement speed issues.
- Added a water‑drinking need and behavior to livestock, allowing them to drink from nearby containers or natural water sources.
- Frog NPC gains a new “interested” state: it searches for shallow water and starts croaking.

### Vehicles
- Introduced a restoreHierarchy field for poolable objects applied to vehicles, fixing UI pooling issues.
- Adjusted suspension, steering, and grip; removed non‑functional burnout/launch; engine revs now use front wheel speed; rear wheels visually lock during handbrake.
- Aim sway now scales with movement speed when aiming held weapons from the passenger seat of the attack helicopter.

### NPC & AI
- Building volumes are now correctly ignored during navmesh baking, and navmesh generation no longer creates unintended areas or fails, improving NPC path‑following reliability.
- Fixed a potential null‑reference crash for mannequins.
- Optimized NPC path‑following logic, roughly doubling performance via selective string‑pulling and reduced interop calls.

### Gameplay & Balance
- SAM sites now have proximity fuses against drones, 2.25× lead speed, and can destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air.
- Unused pies receive doubled bonus durations, and hunters pie bleed reduction increased to 90%.
- Medkits reduce radiation by 20; boat planner tech tree cost lowered to 30; longsword swing radius and delay adjusted for faster, more accurate attacks.
- Swamp tree wood harvest increased to 1000 and oil rig crates now persist across server restarts with refined puzzle resets and improved save/load logic.
- Added a configurable convar for drone detonation distance; ammo models now display remaining rounds for applicable revolvers; tax collector upkeep cost scales with authenticated player count via tiered percentages; random skin crafting can now yield the default skin.

### UI
- Various UI fixes: store prop drawer fallback image, FadeCanvasGroup null‑reference protection, corrected arrow revamp icons, hotbar swapping with overstacks moved server‑side, repair bench functionality restored, and cached skin ID issue resolved.

items.text: Fixed heavy scientists getting stuck after being dropped by the helicopter on certain seeds (small oilrig).
